meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 它给已经放进 HyperFrames 合成的音频做混音：加淡入淡出和交叉淡化、调轨道增益/音量、写音量或效果参数自动化、做音乐床对人声的闪避（carve）、挂效果链（EQ、压缩、限幅、混响等），也能用一个子混音总线管多条轨道。产出是处理后的混音。
howto.when: 当音频已经放进 HyperFrames 合成、需要做混音时接管，比如淡入淡出、音量自动化或人声闪避。找音频、生成音频归 /media-use，片段时序和轨道布局归 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 给这段人声加 0.5 秒淡入和 1 秒淡出
say.note: 写成淡入淡出包络，预览与渲染一致

say.text: 这段音频听起来闷，先看 presets 里的 Reduce Mud 预设
say.note: 按症状表给出预设和频段

howto.what_en: Mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain and volume, volume or effect-parameter automation, voiceover carve, effect chains (EQ, compressor, reverb), and a submix bus for several tracks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when placed audio in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing: fades, volume automation, voiceover carve. Not for sourcing audio (/media-use) or clip timing and layout (/hyperframes-core).

say_en.text: Carve the music track under the voiceover group
say_en.note: Ducks only voice bands; later group members are covered

say_en.text: Add a 0.5s fade-in and 1s fade-out to this voice track
say_en.note: Writes fade envelopes; preview matches render

say_en.text: This audio sounds muffled — check the Reduce Mud preset first
say_en.note: Symptom table points to presets and bands
